coverage.assessment: The main chain holds: landing, caravan, coal/iron/steam, railways, Charles and Henry's division of labor, Boston and Newport, the press survey, Evarts, and Washington. The reformers' rationale is reduced to adjectives (F7). Washington arrival and lodging are dropped (F5).
'It was rural' now attaches to 'the country' rather than the town (F2). 'One of them' has no antecedent (F3). 'His rooms' is unintroduced after the arrival paragraph was cut (F5).
Seward's 'A very sensible entertainment!' and Evarts's reported 'anvil' line are intact and correctly attributed. Lamar's remark is attributed to Lamar.

Chase's dual role on Legal Tender, Motley as historian turned diplomatist, Evarts as Attorney General, and McCulloch as the apparent exception are all stated correctly. Grant's cabinet is not mentioned.
The opening admission that they 'could not wholly know' is gone (F1). The scene of Adams watching Sumner avoid all mention of his family is cut (F4).
The ironic third-person voice and the aphorisms survive. Some dry closers and image-bearing lines were trimmed (F6).
The 'chaos breeds life' turn keeps a thinner footing once 'the whole government ... rotten' is removed (F7). The self-exculpation irony and the education verdict remain intact.
All three endpoints survive locally and in the revised partners 037 and 009.

dependencies.assessment: The caravan image and the night landing with Motley survive locally. The revised 037 echoes both.

dependencies.assessment: The rule is stated as near-absolute, with McCulloch named as the apparent exception. The revised 009 states the rule's origin.

findings.claim: The revision deletes the sentences saying the arrivals could not wholly know the change and that the land itself knew no more. Paragraph 2 now opens on a flat general assertion about Society.
findings.counterevidence: 'Almost as blindly' still carries some of the blindness.

evidence.quote: How much its character had changed or was changing, they could not wholly know, and they could but partly feel.
How much its character had changed or was changing, they could not wholly know, and they could but partly feel.
Society in America was always trying, almost as blindly as an earthworm, to realize and understand itself;

findings.minimal_repair: Restore the first sentence ('How much its character had changed ... partly feel.') at the head of paragraph 2.
findings.plan_relation: Not optional. The plan's voice profile stresses hedging.
findings.reader_effect: This loses the hedged, shared blindness that motivates the earthworm image and the book's 'one sees what one brings' stance. The transition from the night landing to the general analysis also becomes abrupt.

findings.counterevidence: The previous paragraph ends with the volunteers ('They came mostly from the army'), so readers can recover the referent.

findings.claim: The revision cuts the observation that Sumner made no inquiry about Adams's family and talked only of the present. That was the only concrete, observed sign of the rupture with Mr. Adams, and the 'practical education' Adams drew from watching it.
findings.counterevidence: 'Eight years of broken ties' survives, and the revised 009 narrates the break with the family.

evidence.quote: since he made no inquiry about any of Adams's family, or allusion to any of his friends or his residence abroad. He talked only of the present.
since he made no inquiry about any of Adams's family, or allusion to any of his friends or his residence abroad.

findings.counterevidence: The core retrospective point about a strong Executive survives.

findings.minimal_repair: Restore the two first-draft sentences 'No one denied ... improvised.'

strengths: The landing paragraph, with the Tyrian-traders comparison and Motley as 'historian of the Dutch, no longer historian but diplomatist', is preserved nearly whole.
The compression of paragraph 2 keeps the earthworm loop and the vehement 'not himself at fault' irony.
The Charles/Henry division of labor and the 'expected to blackmail' line are kept, alongside V4 'He was for sale, in the open market.'
The doubt over leaving Boston stays unresolved ('Even after life was over, the doubt could not be determined').
Chase's author/enemy irony and the anvil exchange are intact. The chapter still ends on its education verdict and the Government-resembles-Adams punchline.
summary: The revision keeps every essential beat, all eight verbatim passages and the continuity checks. It also cuts optional material cleanly. The extra cuts it makes beyond the first draft leave a few small faults: a misattached pronoun in the village description, a lost opening hedge about limited knowledge, and the loss of the one behavioral sign of Sumner's rupture with the family. A dangling 'one of them' comes from the first draft. Several voice-bearing closers and the reform rationale were also thinned. None of these is a blocker. All three dependencies hold.
